name: The Tear of the Moons
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The power was mine! In my very hands! And I want it back! Back I say!

Those dirty excavators uncovered it... so beautiful it was. Deemed the Tear of the Moons, it was the first great discovery we made at Bael Modan.

It should have been mine! Mine I say!

General Twinbraid grew jealous of the power it gave me. He locked it away in the Keep. Called it cursed, he did! The fool!

Others wanted it and they had to be stopped! That bastard Twinbraid drove me off.

Now I want it back. Back I say!
narrative.objectives: Feegly the Exiled wants you to retrieve for him the Tear of the Moons.
narrative.offerRewardText: At last, the power is mine again! Mine I say!
narrative.requestItemsText: Where is the Tear of the Moons? I need it now! Need I say!
